sources.label: SemiAnalysis InferenceX
sources.title: InferenceX (formerly InferenceMAX) open benchmark results, public API snapshot
sources.notes: Latest snapshot of GET /api/v1/benchmarks for DeepSeek-R1-0528, gpt-oss-120b and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-FP8, read on 2026-11-17. Each stack names its GitHub Actions run and each point its API row; /api/v1/reproduce?id=<row> shows the stored configuration. Kept only single-node, non-disaggregated rows without speculative decoding or expert parallelism, whose exact Hugging Face checkpoint is recorded. The repository is Apache-2.0 and the dashboard FAQ says all data is freely available; the API carries no separate data licence. InferenceX is a SemiAnalysis trademark; citing it implies no endorsement.

families.label: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct and its quantized checkpoints
families.basis: The NVIDIA and AMD checkpoints are FP8, FP4 or MXFP4 quantizations of Llama 3.3 70B Instruct; Llama 3.1 70B Instruct has the same architecture with earlier post-training. Speed carries across them more closely than quality, which needs its own check.

families.label: DeepSeek-R1 and its quantized checkpoints
families.basis: DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-R1-0528 share one architecture; the AMD and NVIDIA checkpoints are MXFP4 or NVFP4 quantizations of DeepSeek-R1-0528.

families.label: gpt-oss-120b and its quantized checkpoints
families.basis: The AMD checkpoint keeps the MXFP4 weights of gpt-oss-120b and runs activations in FP8.
